title: SQLite backup: online backup API wrapper and POST /admin/backup
description: Implement SQLite online backup (sqlite3_backup_init/step/finish API via sqlx or direct rusqlite) that is safe while the database is live. Add POST /admin/backup to admin endpoint: triggers backup of all configured databases to [backup] dest_dir with timestamped filenames. Returns JSON list of backup file paths.
